title: Polynomial-in-$r$ bounds for forbidden traces of uniform hypergraphs
summary: We give a general principle that converts fixed-uniformity bounds for forbidden traces into bounds with polynomial dependence on the uniformity. More precisely, let $H$ be a fixed set system on $h\ge1$ vertices, and suppose that, for some $α\ge0$, $\operatorname{ex}_j(m,\operatorname{Tr}(H))=O_{H,j}(m^α)$ for every fixed integer $j\ge1$. Then, for every $\varepsilon>0$, there is a constant $C_{H,α,\varepsilon}$ such that \[ \operatorname{ex}_r(m,\operatorname{Tr}(H)) \le C_{H,α,\varepsilon} r^{h-1-α+\varepsilon}m^α\] for all $m\ge r\ge2$.
